name: chapel stone pillar
description: A worn stone pillar supports the roof above the nave. Candle soot darkens the side facing the altar.

name: torn expedition canvas
description: The tent wall has been pulled away from its stakes. Folded canvas and snapped ties lie on the groundsheet, leaving a gap wide enough to pass through.

name: message tied to the camp cordon
description: A folded warning is tied to a stake beside the southern entrance. Rain has blurred the first line, but a hurried account of the alarm test is still legible.

name: blackened chapel altar
description: Black candle wax fills the joints of the altar. Torn cloth hides older carvings; a line of bloody handprints leads toward the recess behind it.

name: last vigil's prayer sheet
description: A wax-stained sheet has been pinned beside the altar. The final lines are written across the earlier prayer, in a different hand.

name: exposed oak roots
description: Roots twist above the soil like knotted ropes. They slow a crossing but leave the way open on either side.

name: traveler's remains among the roots
description: Roots have grown through a torn woolen wrapping. One hand still rests beside the notch where a cutting tool broke.

name: broken cave support
description: A split wooden prop rests on a dry ledge. An iron bar and a coil of rope were left beside it; a scrap of writing is caught beneath the end.
